headline: Ukraine says its AI-guided gun turrets have shot down Russia's fastest jet-powered drones for the first time.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: an official Ukrainian confirmation that robotic turrets work against the hardest drones to stop, with the doubt (own account, no kill count) stated in the line.
importance_line: Kyiv residents and Ukraine's air defence, which Inhat says stops 50% to 70% of jet-powered drones against over 85% of older propeller types, gain a possible answer to the fastest ones, but this is Ukraine's own account, the guns have a limited range and no kill count or turret type was given.
summary: Business Insider reports, citing Air Force spokesperson Yurii Inhat, that Ukraine's AI-guided robotic gun turrets have for the first time shot down Russian jet-powered attack drones, including the Geran-5, Russia's newest and fastest jet-powered model at up to 375 mph. In our 5 Oct edition a UA.NEWS report, citing analyst Serhiy Beskrestnov, said twelve turrets were in place in Kyiv; new since then are the Air Force's confirmation of the first kills and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's statement, made on Sunday, that more than a dozen now stand around the city, with eight more planned for the wider region.
notes: Read in full on Business Insider (end of its text cut off). Continues our 5 Oct 2026 item 58 (UA.NEWS, citing Serhiy Beskrestnov). The 50% to 70% interception rate in the article is Ukraine's overall rate against jet-powered drones (Inhat's figure), not the turrets' own, so it appears only in the importance line, attributed to him.
